question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

The company has to be able to __compete__ globally.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"compete"** means to strive to gain or win something by defeating or establishing superiority over others. (प्रतिस्पर्धा करना)

 
 
• **Example: **Many athletes **compete** in the Olympics to win gold medals.
 
 
 
• **"Support"** means to give assistance to, especially financially; to enable to function or act. (समर्थन करना)
 
 
• **Example: **Parents often **support **their children in their education and career choices.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **"compete"** is **"support"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Pervert** (विकृत करना): To alter something from its original course, meaning, or state to a distortion or corruption of what was first intended.

 
 
• **Example:** He was accused of attempting to **pervert** the course of justice.
 
 
 
• **Attack** (आक्रमण करना): To take aggressive action against a place or enemy forces with weapons or armed force.
 
 
• **Example: **The soldiers prepared to **attack** the enemy at dawn.
 
 
 
• **Impede** (बाधा डालना): To delay or prevent someone or something by obstructing them; hinder.
 
 
• **Example:** The heavy traffic might **impede **our progress to the meeting.
